lines.t: His voice the calm that soothes my sleep
Through valleys deep, through waters wide
I feel His hand, it holds me near
Through every storm, He clears my fear
Yahushua is my shepherd, I shall not want
He leads me to the waters, the battles He fought
His love's my anchor, my shelter, my song
Yahushua is my shepherd, I shall not want
Green pastures spread, His gift of grace
He wipes the tears from every face
The darkest night turns into dawn
With every step, His light will show
Yahushua is my shepherd, I shall not want
He leads me to the waters, the battles He fought
His love's my anchor, my shelter, my song
Yeah, who's sure is my shepherd, I shall not want
